searchText: hi, is there a minimum cpu passmark score needed to create a validator node? for phase 0? Doubt it. It runs off a potato so a rasp pi is more than enough? Yeah, there's a few people running beacon node and validators off Pi today Depends on if you're using your own ETH1 node, if you are then I'd say min spec is based on that requirement But you don't need to run an ETH1 node or a beacon node to run a validator, just need to connect to one.
